On Thursday evenings, Max reviews the notes from class. Max bought a T-shirt online because it was much cheaper. Little by little, things began to change. Off the peg fits no one perfectly.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Max thanked Tom for the honest advice. Max believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, the sommelier paired a riesling with the curry.
Tom and Max are preparing a report about the online shop. Max wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The online shop looked quieter than usual that evening. Also, made-to-order cuts the waste.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Tom advised Max to try reading as a new hobby. The supermarket has become an important part of daily life. For example, check the label before washing.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Tom always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
